BiblicalUsage: Jehucal is named once, in Jeremiah 38:1. In Jeremiah 38:1 we read, "Then Shephatiah the son of Mattan, and Gedaliah the son of Pashur, and Jucal the son of Shelemiah..."
TheologicalSignificance: Jehucal was counted by God, and what moves me is that the name is still here.
